Measurements: All garment measurements are in inches. Compare with a T-shirt that fits well, laid flat. Select from the sizes available above.

Body length: Measure from the high point of the shoulder to the finished hem at the back.

Chest width: Measure across the chest one inch below the armhole with the garment laid flat. This is the flat width, not the chest circumference.

Sleeve length: Measure from the center back of the neck, across the shoulder, to the sleeve hem.
